in_marathi.name: Bahubali
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bahubali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bahubali means 'the one with great strength'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bahu', which means 'great' or 'large', and 'bala', which means 'strength'. Bahubali is a name of reverence and respect, often associated with power and courage.
